title: Cycle (web)
summary: The cycle tracker as a single-file web app: periods, symptoms and predictions.
description:
Log when your period starts and ends, how heavy it is, and how you feel on any day. The app predicts the next period from your recent cycles and can remind you a few days before.

- **Calendar** of past periods and the predicted next one.
- **Insights:** your period lengths and moods over time.
- **Locked** behind your screen lock, with a home-screen widget that counts the days to the next period.

**What it never does:** no ads, no tracking and no account. Your health data stays on this phone and is never sent anywhere.

This version is one HTML file: it also runs in a plain browser, where it keeps its data in that browser.
